mapper.insert: insert into shopping_cart (name, image, user_id, dish_id, setmeal_id, dish_flavor, number, amount, create_time, store_id) values (#{name}, #{image}, #{userId}, #{dishId}, #{setmealId}, #{dishFlavor}, #{number}, #{amount}, #{createTime}, #{storeId})
mapper.update: update shopping_cart set number = #{number} where id = #{id}
